native_checks: native preparation runs separately with progress while body and brain stay at time zero
prepared IDs, intensities, photons, channels and voltage match the previous offline recording exactly
native loader selects prepared sources at time zero with a video preview and real OpenGL brain
pause and release freeze brain, body, receptor clock and frame without resetting neural voltage
recording endpoint pauses exactly, with zero source/relay spikes and synchronized body and brain clocks
native full-brain final voltages and counts match the offline replay exactly
Reset clears the recording, source clamps and graded mode and restores normal video controls

brain_view.representation: MaleCNS cell anchors (somaLocation, then tosomaLocation); not neuron morphology

focused_tests.scope: CPU molecular preparation and playback; ordinary batch cancellation; two existing prepared-playback workflow checks

limits: One ordinary Linux source-app workflow on the physical RTX 4060 Laptop GPU, not a packaged-release or macOS check.
Native preparation uses eight explicit receptors, each with 30,000 microvilli; remaining eye cells are not represented by scaling these responses.
Receptor preparation and brain playback are separate phases; no live molecular feedback or calibrated terminal release is added.
Exposure, RGB transfer, receptor projection and release remain explicit unfitted assumptions.
Native final full-brain voltage and spike-count hashes match the earlier offline replay; no new physiological accuracy claim.
